Professional fashion photograph, waist-up portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the navel, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Mexican woman, mid 20s, with an extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, and a cherry-pop heroine look brought to life, with a chocolate-brown wavy bob and short curtain bangs. Her complexion is a warm light brown, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in deep cherry brown contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a glossy red shimmer on the lids and tiny red gems at the outer corners, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are small and glossy, in a cherry-red gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a playful smile. A deep cherry-pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A playful, sparkling, wide-eyed gaze with the head tilted slightly. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a cherry-red satin strapless corset-style top with a centre front zipper and white cherry-print trim, and a matching ultra micro bikini bottom in the same fabric and colour worn low on her hips beneath the lower curve of her belly, her pregnant belly fully bare above it, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: polished red enamel cherry earrings on gold hooks and a thin gold chain.

Background: a softly blurred retro soda fountain with pink and red decor and warm bokeh.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest, arms and belly, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of her frame.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
